entries.title: Psalms 129:1
segments: ¶<A Song of the going up.> Great have been my troubles from the time when I was young (let Israel now say);

entries.title: Psalms 129:2
segments: Great have been my troubles from the time when I was young, but my troubles have not overcome me.

entries.title: Psalms 129:3
segments: The ploughmen were ploughing on my back; long were the wounds they made.

entries.title: Psalms 129:4
segments: The Lord is true: the cords of the evil-doers are broken in two.

entries.title: Psalms 129:5
segments: ¶Let all the haters of Zion be shamed and turned back.

entries.title: Psalms 129:6
segments: Let them be like the grass on the house-tops, which is dry before it comes to full growth.

entries.title: Psalms 129:7
segments: He who gets in the grain has no use for it; and they do not make bands of it for the grain-stems.

entries.title: Psalms 129:8
segments: And those who go by do not say, The blessing of the Lord be on you; we give you blessing in the name of the Lord.
